subject: Private exchange: auth flow, DNS/mTLS, and embeddings/rerank plan
messages:
From: Alex Moss <alex.moss@spectrasys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Infra Ops <infra-ops@spectrasys.com>
Date: 2028-03-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Spectra / Redwood — post-call summary and immediate asks

Thanks again for the intro call earlier today — good energy and very helpful framing. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can scope the POC: 

High-level need
- Secure private connectivity from our app fleet to Redwood inference for embeddings + reranking. Low latency and no public egress for inference traffic.

Network constraints
- We are on AWS in us-west-2. We prefer a PrivateLink-style endpoint or a VPC endpoint/peering model depending on tradeoffs.
- We cannot open broad CIDR ranges; we'll provide narrow outbound SNAT IP ranges.

Auth + TLS
- Prefer mTLS for service-to-service once the PrivateLink is in place.
- API-level auth: our identity team is pushing a JWT-signed approach from our IdP (Authro). We'll need to understand token exchange and claim checks.

Platform needs (integration)
- Redwood SDK usage for structured output and tool calling in the app.
- Proposal for embedding pipeline: we plan to store vectors in-house and call Redwood for realtime embeddings and a reranker endpoint. Need guidance on batch vs realtime.

Immediate asks
1) A short network sketch (diagram) for PrivateLink vs VPC-peering options.
2) A JWT auth flow diagram and list of required claim checks.
3) Estimated throughput/cost for 10k requests/day (50k tokens/day) to size the POC.

We copied infra and partner (Cindy at OpsEdge) — Cindy helps with certificate lifecycle if we go mTLS. Happy to jump on a 30 min tech session next week.

Thanks,
Alex Moss
Head of Platform Integrations
Spectra Systems
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moss <alex.moss@spectrasys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Infra Ops <infra-ops@spectrasys.com>, Cindy Park <cindy.park@opsedge.com>
Date: 2028-03-08T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spectra / Redwood — post-call summary and immediate asks

Alex — thanks for the clear summary. This aligns with what we heard. I'll own coordination from Redwood side. Quick responses inline and then a proposed plan: 

Network sketch
- Attached: spectra_vpc_sketch.png (two quick options: PrivateLink endpoint in us-west-2 vs dedicated VPC peering with NAT egress). PrivateLink keeps egress strictly inside AWS and simplifies DNS; peering gives more control but requires route management.

JWT + mTLS
- Attached: jwt-auth-flow.pdf that shows two options: short-lived bearer token (our recommended, validated per-request) vs token exchange + mTLS for mutual auth on the private path. If you want mTLS, Cindy/OpsEdge will help with cert rotation.

Embeddings & rerank
- We typically recommend realtime embeddings for low-latency hits and small minibatches for throughput. For your volume (10k requests/day) realtime looks fine; we'll include a cost estimate. See redwood-embed-rerank-guidelines.md attached for config knobs (quantization, cache TTLs).

Proposed next steps
1) Technical sync: 30 min on Tue 2028-03-10 10:00 PDT — confirm?
2) Spectra to share outbound SNAT IP ranges + an initial list of CIDR blocks to allow.
3) Redwood to produce short POC plan with milestones and estimated monthly compute.

Owners (Redwood)
- Marissa Cole (PM, integration) — overall coordination
- Ben Carter (Solutions, technical lead) — SDK/auth/resolver details
- Lauren Bishop (Networking) — DNS/mTLS and peering options

If that timeline works I'll lock the calendar and Ben and Lauren will bring the technical details.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moss <alex.moss@spectrasys.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Infra Ops <infra-ops@spectrasys.com>
Date: 2028-03-09T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spectra / Redwood — post-call summary and immediate asks

Alex / team — quick technical clarifications ahead of Tue: 

SDK & auth
- Redwood SDK supports two transport modes for private connections: (A) HTTPS over PrivateLink with per-request bearer tokens, (B) mTLS (mutual TLS) where the SDK performs client cert auth and we additionally verify a short-lived token in the request body.
- For your IdP JWT idea: we validate exp/iss/aud + a custom claim (spectra:org_id). We can also perform token introspection via your token endpoint if you'd prefer.

Token exchange pattern (recommended)
1) App obtains IdP JWT from Authro (1hr expiry).
2) Backend exchanges for Redwood short-lived token via our token-exchange endpoint (server-to-server).
3) Backend calls Redwood inference endpoints using the short-lived token, over PrivateLink.

Structured output/tool-calling
- SDK can accept a structured output schema. For reranking: send candidate ids and embeddings metadata, Redwood returns a rank-ordered list plus confidence scores. We'll provide example request/response shapes in the sync.

Embeddings pipeline
- For realtime embedding calls: keep batches <= 64 for low latency; for bulk indexing we recommend batch uploads to the embedding endpoint (we can provide a parallel upload script).

Attachments
- I've attached redwood-embed-rerank-guidelines.md with recommended hyperparams + cache TTLs.

Action items for the call
- Alex: share SNAT IPs + confirm whether you prefer PrivateLink (we provision an endpoint service) or VPC peering.
- Cindy: confirm cert management preference (OpsEdge -> certs vs Spectra self-manage).

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Infra Ops <infra-ops@spectrasys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Moss <alex.moss@spectrasys.com>, Cindy Park <cindy.park@opsedge.com>
Date: 2028-03-10T10:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spectra / Redwood — post-call summary and immediate asks

Thanks Ben — a few follow-ups from our infra team after reviewing the attachments: 

1) We prefer PrivateLink if Redwood can support internal DNS mapping so our services resolve redwood-embed.redwood.internal -> ENI private IP. How do you recommend handling internal DNS?
2) Certificate rotation for mTLS: OpsEdge can run cert rotation. We'd like Redwood to support a short cert bundle upload API or ACME automation if possible.
3) Egress & NAT: we'll provide two /32 SNAT IPs for outbound; confirm that Redwood allowlisting those IPs will suffice for your side of the PrivateLink.
4) Bandwidth: preliminary load is 10k calls/day with 200 tokens avg/call. Can you provide a compute bucket estimate (gpus / vcpu) and an expected 95th percentile latency target?

Also added a short excerpt of our security checklist: we require TLS 1.3, mTLS optional but preferred, and a retention policy for logs (90 days).

Thanks,
Spectra Infra (on behalf of Alex)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moss <alex.moss@spectrasys.com>, Infra Ops <infra-ops@spectrasys.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Cindy Park <cindy.park@opsedge.com>
Date: 2028-03-12T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spectra / Redwood — post-call summary and immediate asks

Thanks — great clarification, everyone. Confirming agreed path and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Agreed architecture (POC)
- PrivateLink in us-west-2 with internal DNS mapping. Redwood will publish an endpoint service and provide the canonical CNAMEs for your hosted zone.
- Auth: token-exchange pattern + short-lived Redwood token for per-request auth. mTLS optional for the POC; OpsEdge to demonstrate cert rotation.
- Embeddings: realtime calls for initial traffic; batch path for bulk reindexing.

Deliverables & timeline
1) Redwood (Ben / Lauren) by 2028-03-16: short POC runbook (network steps, DNS entries, sample SDK calls, size estimate).
2) Spectra (Infra) by 2028-03-14: provide SNAT /32 IPs, security checklist doc, and confirm cert rotation owner.
3) Joint sync 2028-03-20: review POC runbook and target initial test window 2028-03-22 -> 2028-03-29.

Attachments & links
- Attached in this thread: spectra_vpc_sketch.png, jwt-auth-flow.pdf, redwood-embed-rerank-guidelines.md
- Link to shared workspace: https://redwood.app/s/DEAL-7321

If everyone confirms these owners/timeline I'll create the calendar invites and open a short HubSpot playbook for tracking milestones.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
